title: Newman's conjecture, kernel-checked: Lambda >= 0 for the de Bruijn-Newman constant in Lean 4 along Dobner's proof
description: Lean 4 formalization, verification records and paper for Newman's conjecture Lambda >= 0 (Rodgers-Tao's theorem) along Dobner's 2020 proof: for every t < 0 the heat-flowed Riemann xi function H_t has a zero off the real axis (dbn_newman, Arda dbn island, Lean v4.34.0-rc1, Mathlib de5ce8a9). The proof depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; the registry node RH_dbn_newman was read back by an independent operator, granted through the verify gate and judged by openai/ten-proofs Comparator with nanoda as second kernel against a challenge whose type is the registered statement (CI runs 38062595826 and 38070548082). Kernel-checked infrastructure new to the project: complex Stirling with explicit remainder and the digamma asymptotic, Bohr almost periodicity for everywhere absolutely convergent Dirichlet series, the Gaussian-convolution representation of H_t and a saddle-point analysis (Dobner's Theorem 4, qualitative). With the registry's Lambda <= 1/2 (de Bruijn) and Lambda <= 9/32 (OpenAI's quasi-Riemann hypothesis) the kernel-checked range is 0 <= Lambda <= 9/32. Lambda = 0 is the Riemann Hypothesis and is not proved. Not yet refereed. Licensing: Lean sources and scripts Apache-2.0; paper and prose CC-BY-4.0.
